Confusion matrix and overall agreement between bcwsft and provincial fuel types

Source: R/fuel_typing.R
compare_fuel_typing.Rd

Assigns each bcwsft polygon the provincial code it most overlaps (largest-overlap spatial join), then tabulates agreement.

Usage

compare_fuel_typing(bcwsft_sf, provincial_sf)

Arguments

bcwsft_sf

sf with a FUEL_TYPE_CD column from run_bcwsft_fuel_typing().

provincial_sf

sf with a FUEL_TYPE_CD column (a provincial fuel-types layer).

Value

A list with confusion (table), agreement (proportion of matched polygons), and n (number of compared polygons).
